title: banking_knowledge v1.0.1 — upstream scorer vs verified scorer
intro: Two independent reviews of the same 97 tasks on 2026-10-13, identical prompts, inputs, task batches, and model (claude-opus-5-5, effort high); only the DB scorer differs. 'Repeat' is an earlier same-scorer review (draft-1, unverified, older prompt wording) used to measure run-to-run noise. Reconciliation resolves differences that are not caused by the scorer; any difference left after it is a scorer effect.
